preconditions.description: The input string s has a length between 1 and 99 (inclusive) and is divisible by 3.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in s are uppercase English letters (A-Z).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) if s[i] != 'S' if i % 3 == 0 else s[i] != 'O' if i % 3 == 1 else s[i] != 'S')
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of mismatched characters between the received signal s and the expected SOS pattern (SOS repeated len(s)/3 times). A mismatch occurs when a character at position i in s does not match 'S' if i mod 3 is 0 or 2, or 'O' if i mod 3 is 1.
